verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs describe single-item operations (.remember, .recall, .forget, .improve) and dataset-level deletion ('Dataset deletion: remove an entire dataset', 'Full cleanup: remove everything'), which implies some bulk-scope actions, but there's no documented batch/bulk API for ingesting or processing many discrete items in one call (e.g., no bulk upload endpoint, no batch job status, no evidence of throughput/rate limits for large-scale ingestion). missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch ingestion API, bulk update/enrich across many items in one call, evidence of scale/performance for large batch operations, independent confirmation of bulk workflows beyond single-call ingestion.
